summary: Stocks slid midday as an AI sell-off weighed on the Nasdaq after disappointing OpenAI revenue details, and surging oil prices added fresh inflation fears. Volatility rose and bitcoin fell as risk appetite drained.
market_note: Nasdaq down on AI caution; crude jumps on Hormuz tanker attacks; 10Y Treasury near 5.3%.

items.why: Volatility climbed as stocks slid on AI caution after disappointing OpenAI revenue details, plus fresh selling spurred by rising oil prices.
Crude jumped as Iranian attacks in the Strait of Hormuz hit record levels, slashing tanker traffic, while Hurricane Isais threatened Gulf Coast production.
Bitcoin fell as rising Treasury yields and oil-driven inflation fears triggered risk-off selling; spot ETFs saw $484.9M in outflows on Oct 7.
Nasdaq fell under AI sell-off pressure after OpenAI revenue details disappointed, with analysts debating whether the AI rally is a bubble.
